title: Native New Reservation details cleanup
lede: Pickup and Return stay on one line. Title and the window share a plan card. Choose Gear names the missing requirement instead of failing silently.

stats.n: Was two full-time menus that crushed Return into a vertical stack and inherited brand red.
Title/When and pickup/kit are grouped. Empty kit lists no longer take a whole card.

sections.heading: After
sections.note: After-only iPhone 16 Pro (iOS 27) fixture capture in light appearance, 1206×2622 px, create-booking-events after selecting MBB vs Duke. Hash-bound pair receipts were not recorded against the reported dark-mode device screenshot because device, appearance, clock, and pixel dimensions differ. Reported defect: tasks/archive/proofs/ios-reservation-when-row-2026-09-17/reported-broken.png. After: tasks/archive/proofs/ios-reservation-when-row-2026-09-17/after-details.png.

changes.was: Two menu pickers each showed the full time, so Pickup vanished and Return stacked letter-by-letter. Times used brand red.
changes.now: One compact date control and one 15-minute time menu per row. Labels stay on a single line. Time menus use reservation purple.

changes.was: Title, When, pickup, and kit were four separate cards. Toolbar Back sat next to Cancel on later steps.
changes.now: Title and the window share a plan card; pickup and kit share the next. Completed steps in the progress strip go back.

changes.was: Choose Gear disabled with no reason. Review on Gear did the same.
changes.now: Choose Gear states the missing requirement. Gear Review exposes the same reason to VoiceOver.

changes.was: Pickup/return used a weekday+date stamp. A selected kit was invisible.
changes.now: Review uses the shared operational date language and names the gameday kit as provenance.

verification: Wisconsin iPhone 16 Pro Debug build succeeded.
Wisconsin generic iOS device Debug build succeeded earlier in this slice.
CreateBookingEventPickerScreenshotUITests.testEventPickerCaptures passed on iPhone 16 Pro (27.0), including Pickup and Return labels on the details step.

Focused source contracts for compact details, three-step progression, kit calling, and native search passed. Unrelated dirty-tree failures remain in Bookings search mounting, reservation drafts, TipKit configure, and visible-row conflict preview.
notes: The reported screenshot is a signed-in dark-mode device capture of FB vs Eastern Michigan. The after shot is a light fixture capture of MBB vs Duke. Do not treat them as a matched pair.
Gameday kit sits in the pickup card below Camp Randall / Kohl Center; it is one scroll below this frame because Choose Gear is pinned.
Authenticated physical iPhone 16 Pro proof of the live reservation composer remains open. No commit or deploy in this slice.
